payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute LNDS of species array with 1D DP: dp[i] = 1 + max_{j<i, s[j]<=s[i]} dp[j].
payload.rationale: The solution finds the maximum number of plants that can stay if their species order is non-decreasing (LNDS). This is a classic 1D DP, not 2D, as the state is a single array k[i] representing the longest valid subsequence ending at i.
